verdict.rationale: A system-to-system filing channel, such as bulk or transmitter enrollment, is a fair question for a state business registry, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no documented system accounts, transmitter program, batch-provider channel or published enrollment path. The 'UCC/EFS/Buyer E-Filing System (Authorized Users)' entry and the Commercial Registered Agent registration are adjacent human-facing portal and agent-status features, not documented machine channels. Probes found no public API, OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and WyoBiz filings sit behind ordinary authenticated web accounts.
